displayName: Audi R8 V10 Performance RWD (4S / 2nd gen)

production.note: US model years. First: Motor Authority (Viknesh Vijayenthiran, 27 April 2021) on the 2022 line-up: "the R8 V10 Performance RWD, the rear-wheel-drive R8 variant develops 562 hp" and "Pricing for the 2022 R8 starts at $146,500". The 2021 R8 V10 RWD (532 hp) is a separate, earlier variant with a different name and rating and is not covered by this record: Carscoops (Dan Mihalascu), "2021 Audi R8 V10 RWD Joins U.S. Lineup As The Cheapest Model At $145,895" (carscoops-r8-rwd-2021); Motor Authority (Kirk Bell): "The 2021 Audi R8 V10 Coupe RWD starts at $145,895" (motorauthority-r8-rwd-2021). Last: Audi of America: "2023 was the final model year for the R8" (audi-usa-r8-coupe). The 2018 limited-run R8 V10 RWS is not part of this record.

body.note: The open R8 V10 performance Spyder RWD is sold under its own name and is not part of this record.

displacementL.note: Audi: "5.2 FSI". autoevolution (a database) gives "5204 cm3 (318 ci)" for its RWD entry, which is the earlier 540 PS RWD car, not this 562 hp version (autoevolution-r8-4s); the engine is the same 5.2 V10 FSI.

aspiration.note: Inferred: a 5.2-liter V10 FSI with no forced induction.

transmission.note: "RWD 7-speed S tronic® with overdrive"; S tronic is a dual-clutch gearbox and the only transmission offered. Motor Authority on the 2022 car: "the only transmission is a 7-speed dual-clutch unit" (motorauthority-r8-2022).

powerHp.note: Quote (Audi of America, 2023 R8 Coupe specification table, column "R8 V10 performance Coupe RWD"): "Horsepower (hp) | 562". Motor Authority on the 2022 car: "the R8 V10 Performance RWD, the rear-wheel-drive R8 variant develops 562 hp and 406 lb-ft of torque from the familiar 5.2-liter V-10" (motorauthority-r8-2022). Predecessor (not part of this record): the 2021 R8 V10 RWD was rated 532 hp. Carscoops: "the V10 in the R8 RWD makes 532 HP (540 PS) and 398 lb-ft (539 Nm) of torque" (carscoops-r8-rwd-2021); Motor Authority: "tuned to make 532 horsepower and 398 pound-feet of torque" (motorauthority-r8-rwd-2021).

weightLb.note: Quote (Audi of America, 2023 R8 Coupe specification table, column "R8 V10 performance Coupe RWD"): "Curb weight (lb) | 3,571". Coupe, 7-speed S tronic (the only configuration). Reference year 2023 is the earliest year for which a manufacturer weight was found.
